name: crra_tstat_near_floor_wealth
purpose: Pins the W-H4 contract: floor applied to W (input), NOT to U (output). A floor-hitting day (r_policy_pct = -99.99%) produces W_raw = 0.0001 < WEALTH_ARG_FLOOR = 0.001. The W-side floor clamps W to 0.001 before CRRA, yielding U_floor_day = crra(0.001, gamma=2.0) = -999.0. A U-side floor at -10 would clip U_floor_day to -10.0 (different) and shrink sd(U) from ~377 to ~3.78 -- catching the anti-conservative inflation. The t-stat computed on the W-side-floored series is finite.
provenance: Non-circular: W_raw derived from r_policy_pct via W = 1 + r/100. W_floored = max(WEALTH_ARG_FLOOR, W_raw). U = crra(W_floored, gamma=2.0) = (W^(1-2) - 1)/(1-2) = 1 - 1/W. All arithmetic done by hand from the W-H2 formula; no SUT output used.

expected.discriminating_note: W-side floor: U[3] = crra(0.001) = -999.0, sd(U) = 377.6. A U-side floor at -10 clips U[3] to -10 and shrinks sd to 3.78 -- a ~100x difference. The test asserts U[3] == crra(WEALTH_ARG_FLOOR, gamma) exactly, proving the floor was on W.

tolerance_notes.U_floor_day: exact equality (-999.0 is an exact IEEE-754 double)
